findings.title: Hook settings read fails open to off
findings.problem: readSettings returns {obfuscation:'off'} on any error, while the proxy fails closed. claude-code-otlp and copilot-cli-otlp call resolveAnalyticsSettings(cwd) unguarded, so an undefined cwd throws and drops the event.
findings.impact: With obfuscation on, a failed or unusable settings read lets PII leave un-obfuscated on hook routes (AC8 protective value), or drops the event on the two unguarded callers. Reachability not fully confirmed beyond the lens report.
findings.recommendation: Return {obfuscation:'on'} in the catch, guard typeof cwd==='string' in resolveAnalyticsSettings, and route the two direct callers through the guarded helper.
findings.check_notes: readSettings fails closed to on; resolveAnalyticsSettings tolerates non-string cwd and never throws.

fix.change: Hook settings read fails closed to on; resolveAnalyticsSettings tolerates a non-string cwd

findings.title: git_branch and repo_remote skip obfuscation
findings.problem: mergeCommonFields merges git_branch/repo_remote into events without sanitizeText, unlike the Cowork path.
findings.impact: Branch names or remotes containing an email or token leave unobfuscated on non-Cowork events when obfuscation is on. Reachability not fully confirmed beyond the lens report.
findings.recommendation: sanitizeText(commonFields.git_branch, mode) and the remote before merging.

fix.change: git_branch and repo_remote sanitized in on mode before merge

findings.title: Off-mode masking behaviour changed
findings.problem: maskAndBoundFields now splits UNMASKED_FIELD_KEYS at the top level only and uses maskSecretsInLongText; copilot boundedFreeText and the cowork branch also changed masker. Equivalence with the previous maskSecretsDeep/maskSecretsInText off-mode output is not shown (AC7, NG4).
findings.impact: Off-mode output may differ from today's: nested keys previously exempt are now masked, or secrets previously masked are missed. Reachability not fully confirmed beyond the lens report.
findings.recommendation: Keep the previous masker call for mode off, or add regression tests proving byte-equal off-mode output.
findings.check_notes: Off mode routed through sanitizeHookFields with prior maskers per fix log; source shows facade use.

fix.change: Off mode keeps previous maskSecretsDeep/maskSecretsInText via sanitizeHookFields/sanitizeHookText

findings.title: Marker regex regresses existing attribution
findings.problem: extractTicketMarker takes only the first MARKER_RE match, so an early 'story: 42' with no github/gitlab tracker hides a later 'story: ABC-1'. The trailing (?![\w]) also rejects 'story: ABC-12x', which matched before.
findings.impact: Valid Jira story markers that were attributed before are lost. Reachability not fully confirmed beyond the lens report.
findings.recommendation: Iterate matchAll and take the first match that resolves to an id; keep the old no-lookahead form for the Jira alternative.

fix.change: extractTicketMarker iterates all marker phrases; Jira alternative has no trailing lookahead

findings.title: Deferred tool events derive mode from exact rules_version
findings.problem: buildDeferredUsageEvents sets mode on only when template.rules_version === OBFUSCATION_RULES_VERSION; this and mode 'on' for unhooked tool events have no test. Off-mode events carry no rules_version.
findings.impact: After a rules-version bump, in-flight sessions forward unhooked tool args and results un-obfuscated. Reachability not fully confirmed beyond the lens report.
findings.recommendation: Use template['rules_version'] !== undefined for on, and add a test with rules_version and an email in tool args.

fix.change: Deferred tool events take mode on when rules_version is present

findings.title: Proxy ignores project-scoped obfuscation
findings.problem: resolveSessionObfuscationMode awaits readStatus(sessionId), discards the result, and resolves settings from homedir(). session-project.ts is not used. Verified in source.
findings.impact: A project-only 'on' with global 'off' never obfuscates the proxy OTLP JSON or protobuf routes: prompts are spooled raw, breaking AC2 and the session-mapping approach. It also costs an extra disk read per request.
findings.recommendation: Resolve settings from the session's project directory via the existing session-to-project mapping, and return 'on' when the project is unknown.
findings.check_notes: Fixed by design: global read plus session on learned from hook rules_version; residual global-only window before first hook event.

fix.change: Proxy learns project-scoped on from rules_version on session hook events; global read directly

findings.title: Malformed protobuf body dropped in on mode
findings.problem: obfuscateOtlpProtobuf returns null (body dropped, metrics lost) on a malformed body, beyond the two drop causes the spec permits (placeholder step failed, 5 MiB unmet). handleOtlpBinary then returns HTTP 200 with only a warn log and an unread counter.
findings.impact: Metrics are silently lost on a malformed export and the exporter believes delivery succeeded. Reachability not fully confirmed beyond the lens report.
findings.recommendation: Placeholder the unparseable leaves or pass metrics through; return a non-2xx for dropped bodies and rate-limit the warning.

fix.change: Malformed or oversized protobuf answers 400/413, drop warning rate-limited

findings.title: Protobuf walker leaves free-text fields unobfuscated
findings.problem: rewriteKeyValue skips values of session.id, session_id and codemie_project_name by key name only. Only a fixed list of string fields is walked: event_name, metric name/description/unit, scope name/version, trace_state, bytesValue and unknown fields pass through byte for byte.
findings.impact: Any producer can place PII under the skipped keys or in uncovered fields and it passes through in on mode. Reachability not fully confirmed beyond the lens report.
findings.recommendation: Check skipped values look like identifiers, extend the field list, or placeholder unknown string fields.
findings.check_notes: Proof-key and field coverage extended per fix log; not fully re-read.

fix.change: Proof-key values must look like identifiers; event_name, metric name/description/unit, trace_state walked

findings.title: Proxy obfuscation routes have no test
findings.problem: No test drives the OTLP/JSON route (line 384) or the protobuf route and drop branch (422-431) with obfuscation on. Only maskOtlpJson, resolveSessionObfuscationMode and obfuscateOtlpProtobuf are tested in isolation.
findings.impact: Hard-coding 'off', dropping the mode argument or spooling raw bytes passes every test and ships unobfuscated prompts.
findings.recommendation: Add route tests with obfuscation on asserting spooled content has [REDACTED:EMAIL], plus a malformed/oversized protobuf test.

fix.change: Added route tests with obfuscation on for JSON, protobuf and malformed body

findings.title: Deleted config silently turns obfuscation off
findings.problem: readLayer caches ENOENT as ABSENT, so a config deleted or replaced after an 'on' read resolves to off, contradicting AC15 and the never-silently-off guarantee. A first-read parse failure also contributes nothing.
findings.impact: Obfuscation drops to off with no log when the config file disappears.
findings.recommendation: In the ENOENT branch return the prior layer when it was on; treat an unparseable first read as protective.
findings.check_notes: ENOENT keeps prior on layer; unparseable first read is UNREADABLE=on.

fix.change: Deleted on-config keeps on; unparseable first read counts as on

findings.title: Analytics sync git target not obfuscated
findings.problem: The spec Risks section places the analytics sync git target in every-route scope. The diff has no change for it; report and sync obfuscate only session title (AC3).
findings.impact: Sync payloads to the git target can carry unobfuscated text when obfuscation is on.
findings.recommendation: Obfuscate that path through the facade, or record the exclusion with the spec owner.
findings.check_notes: Premise superseded: git target uploads buildSyncReport output, which obfuscates titles; no separate git payload path. Waivable, no code change needed.

findings.title: Canonical samples lack 200/300 limit cases
findings.problem: obfuscation-samples.json has cut cases at limits 3 to 20 only, with no 200/300 limits and no limit variants (AC10, spec item 7).
findings.impact: The cross-repo contract set is thinner than specified, so limit-boundary regressions go unnoticed.
findings.recommendation: Add cases cutting at 200 and 300 and the limit variants.

findings.title: Commit subjects embed the ticket key
findings.problem: All 8 commit subjects carry EPMCDME-17748; git-workflow.md anti-patterns say to put the key in a body footer.
findings.impact: Documented commit-format standard partially failed (blocking standards row).
findings.recommendation: Reword subjects to drop the key and add a 'Refs: EPMCDME-17748' footer.
findings.check_notes: Commit subjects unchanged and still embed EPMCDME-17748; history rewrite or waiver by user. Not a source defect.

findings.title: sanitizeDeep failure blanks every free field
findings.problem: If sanitizeDeep returns the placeholder string in on mode, sanitized[key] is undefined for each free key.
findings.impact: Narrow trigger: only when the whole walk fails; fields become undefined rather than the failure placeholder. Reachability unconfirmed.
findings.recommendation: Fill each free key with OBFUSCATION_FAILURE_PLACEHOLDER when the result is not an object.

fix.change: Failed on-mode walk fills each free field with the failure placeholder

findings.title: Bare #N lookbehind admits URL fragments
findings.problem: The bare-hash lookbehind excludes word characters and '/' but not '.', '-' or '(', so 'file.md#12' attributes a false story for github/gitlab trackers.
findings.impact: Only affects projects with ticketTracker set to github/gitlab and such text in prompts.
findings.recommendation: Tighten the lookbehind to whitespace or start.

fix.change: Bare hash lookbehind requires start or whitespace

findings.impact: Users who pick it believe obfuscation is disabled; no data effect.
findings.recommendation: Hide or warn on project-scope Off.

findings.title: Invalid UTF-8 leaves are rewritten lossy
findings.problem: sanitizeLeaf decodes invalid UTF-8 to U+FFFD, so the rewrite is not byte-faithful.
findings.impact: Needs non-UTF-8 string bytes in a string field; rare.
findings.recommendation: Placeholder or pass through leaves that do not round-trip.

fix.change: Invalid UTF-8 leaf becomes failure placeholder in on mode

business_review.item: AC1: obfuscation selectable, global or per project, default off
AC2: project-scoped on reaches hooks, proxy, report and sync
AC3: PII and secrets become typed placeholders on every route
AC4: ticket refs survive; ticket fields from raw prompt
AC6: bare #123 only for github/gitlab tracker
AC8: failed field becomes failure placeholder, metrics still sent
AC9: versions and ids unchanged, dotted four-part masked
AC10: canonical sample set incl. 200/300 cuts
AC12: protobuf no-op byte-identical, range proof
AC13: worst-case input timing test per PII rule
AC14: only facade imports masking for analytics text
AC15: unreadable config never resolves off when on

standards_review.notes: All 8 subjects embed EPMCDME-17748; git-workflow.md says to use the body footer.
No console.log, require() or missing .js found; function and file length not measured.
Added logger.warn calls log no payload content; no hardcoded secrets.

final_round.rationale: Reachability verified in source for the proxy project-settings gap, adapter readSettings and maskAndBoundFields; the other findings keep lens-derived grading, so confidence is low. Findings: 13 blocking (1 critical), 6 advisory; 0 deferred, 0 dismissed. Standards: commit subjects embed the ticket key.
